WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    raceId,
    AVG(points) as avg_points,
    AVG(wins) as avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points > 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
),
overall_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg_wins
  FROM race_averages
  WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ra.raceId,
  ra.avg_points,
  ra.avg_wins,
  ra.avg_wins - oaw.overall_avg_wins as diff
FROM race_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_wins oaw
WHERE oaw.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN diff IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  diff DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "more than 6.0" is strictly greater than (>), not >=
